entries.german: Heinrich von Rosenberg und seine Gemahlin Barbara bestätigen den Empfang von 2000 Pf. Pfennigen, welche der letzteren Vater, Graf Heinrich von Schaunberg, dieser als Heiratsgut mitgegeben hatte, und verzichten aller Ansprüche auf ferneren väterlichen Erbanteil.
entries.english: Heinrich of Rosenberg der Jüngere and his wife Barbara confirm receipt of 2,000 pounds of pennies, which her father, Count Heinrich of Schaunberg, had given her as dowry, and renounce all claims to further paternal inheritance.

facts.content: confirmed with his wife Barbara receipt of her marriage portion from her father Heinrich, Graf von Schaunberg.
renounced with her husband Heinrich der Jüngere von Rosenberg further claims to her paternal inheritance.
